validity.value: Two identical photos required per application (new, renewal, and replacement)

cross_verification.note_en: FSM's official government portal (fsmgov.org), page 'Procedure to Follow in Filing for FSM Passport', states photo size as '1 3/16 x 1½' inches (≈3.0×3.8cm) and quantity as two identical photos — this size does not match the DB's 3.5×4.5cm and is recorded as a db_conflict without altering the DB. Background, head height, and composition rules were not stated on this page. A related detailed instruction-sheet PDF (fsmembassy.fm) and the official passport application form PDF (fsmgov.org/passport.pdf) could not be parsed by the fetch tool (returned binary/encoded stream data), so any claims reported by secondary aggregator sites about leis/hats/earrings/attire restrictions could not be independently confirmed on an official source and are excluded per the truthfulness gate.
